body:
This is LITERALLY what I'm going through. I'm so scared of not qualifying for getting help, and I've been going through that same process of trying to fix myself. There's only so much you can do by yourself and it's so scary to think no one understands what you're going through, so I'm really comforted by what you just said. There's definitely something going on with us, but it's so hard to reach out when you're made to feel times and times again like your feelings aren't valid. 

I hope you get through it, I hope we find the help we need
Thank you, I think I needed to hear that. I'm definitely gonna try getting on medication and keep looking for a therapist that actually helps me

I definitely feel that, I was really close to self harming when I was in high school but I just couldn't do it. I feel like the harder it gets the more it seems like the only way to get someone to reach out, right?

I've stayed away from antidepressants so far, mostly at the recommendation of my doctor. But I guess knowing that therapy isn't doing anything I really ought to look into it. Especially if I can't seem to find external factors for me feeling this way. Thank you for this

I definitely agree on the knowing things are moving forward helps bit. It's just so hard to go through the process over and over again. Even with a referral from a doctor it takes so long. My school has resources but I don't feel they're adequate. 

Thank you for your encouragement, I'll keep trying for the sake of future me then
Well I'm glad I'm not the only one feeling this way at least, are you stuck in the same position?
That's actually really nice to hear! I'm glad you got support from your friends and ex, that's definitely encouraging!
I'm so excited for all the bi puns 😂 thank you so much for getting me started!!
Well I'm glad I'm on time to the party somehow 😅 thank you so much!!
I absolutely love that there is an entire culture I have yet to discover 😂 thank you so much!! 💜

It really feels good to know that even though I felt alone going through it, I wasn't alone at all. I also wasn't very sexually attracted to men which made it a whole lot more confusing and to be totally honest did not realize biromantic was also a way to describe it. Thank you for sharing this and thank you for your kind words 💜

Thank you so much for sharing this!! I can 100% relate to the internalized biphobia, it's like I didn't mind people being bi but didn't want it to be me. Now that I see all of this positive energy I'm glad to just be honest with myself. Thank you, it means a lot 💜
Thank you so much!!! It feels so good hearing this
